requirements.statement: Each image button (<input type="image">) used as a CAPTCHA meets one of the listed conditions; the methodology also takes in buttons used as an image-test.

citations.quote: Chaque bouton associé à une image (balise `input` avec l’attribut `type="image"`) utilisée comme CAPTCHA vérifie-t-il une de ces conditions ?
utilisés comme CAPTCHA ou comme image-test ;

routes.statement: At least one other, non-graphic form of CAPTCHA exists.

citations.quote: Il existe une autre forme de CAPTCHA non graphique, au moins ;

routes.statement: Another way exists to reach the functionality the CAPTCHA protects.

citations.quote: Il existe une autre solution d’accès à la fonctionnalité sécurisée par le CAPTCHA.

rationale.text: This is test 1.5.1 for image buttons. It applies to <input type="image"> elements whose image is used as a CAPTCHA, which the glossary defines by purpose: a test that tells a human user from a computer. The methodology widens it to buttons used as an image-test. Code can find image buttons but not tell which ones serve as a CAPTCHA, so which elements the test applies to is judgment. The one requirement has two routes, as the wording says one of the conditions is enough: another CAPTCHA form that is not graphic (the glossary names logic questions and sound clips), or another way to reach the protected functionality. Both need judgment to establish, the second possibly outside the page. No axe rule is tagged, and no check could examine either route, so the entry is none with no link. Applicability is judgment, since it depends on recognising a CAPTCHA. Needs is empty: the methodology asks only that the alternatives exist, not that they be operated.

citations.quote: Un CAPTCHA est un test utilisé pour distinguer un utilisateur humain d’un ordinateur.
D’autres formes de CAPTCHA peuvent être basées sur des questions logiques ou des extraits sonores.
